_help: Gavin t200u/t201u 11/04: Eternatus is PRIMARY (lead, slot 1). No good egg moves yet -> learn level-up moves via learn_mode=score (STAB Dragon/Poison or strong coverage replaces the weakest/least useful move; protected moves and best attack never dropped). Gavin t139u/t141u 10/31: Eternatus candy grind. learn_mode=score: every offered move (level-up or TM) is scored = power x acc x STAB(1.5 Poison/Dragon) x (own attack stat / higher attack stat), x0.6 recharge, x0.8 self-drop, +8 per type it newly hits super-effectively; status moves use status_values. Replaces the weakest non-protected move if the new score > weakest x replace_margin; never drops the last damaging STAB move. Stats = game base stats (HP 140 Atk 85 Def 95 SpA 145 SpD 95 Spe 130).
